_comment: SDK native-tool policy for the dev agent, consumed by makeDevRunAgent and passed through the runAgent options seam (NOT by loadAgentConfig). baseTools and disallowedTools map to the SDK tools/disallowedTools options that actually bound the tool set (allowedTools is auto-approve-only and does not restrict). WebFetch and WebSearch are denied so the subprocess has no first-class network egress tool. deniedBashPatterns feed the PreToolUse deny hook (remote-mutating git/gh). deniedReadGlobs feed both the SDK sandbox.filesystem.denyRead and the hook path guard; the per-issue worktree path is the runtime allowedRoots, injected per task, not stored here. network feeds sandbox.network for OS-level egress confinement.
